annotation.authors_or_issuer: Holm, S.; Pedersen, S.M.; Tamirat, T.W.
key_provisions_or_claims: Autonomous field robots raise unresolved questions of moral responsibility among designers, producers and users.
Job loss/change concerns should be addressed with attention to farm workers' perspectives and retraining.
Data control and ownership of farm data generated by robots is a key stakeholder concern.
Findings from sixteen stakeholder interviews in the EU Robs4Crops project inform the recommendations.
Responsible innovation and stakeholder inclusion are advocated.
annotation.summary_en: Journal article discussing ethical concerns about field crop robots—job loss, moral responsibility and data control—based on sixteen stakeholder interviews in the EU Robs4Crops project. It argues autonomy complicates responsibility attribution and offers recommendations for socially responsible introduction of agricultural robots.
annotation.title_clean: Robots in agriculture – A case-based discussion of ethical concerns on job loss, responsibility, and data control
annotation.title_en: Robots in agriculture – A case-based discussion of ethical concerns on job loss, responsibility, and data control
